adr: docs/architecture/adr-beyond-vram-worlds.md sections 8.2-8.4 and the M1 checkpoint criterion in section 10

method: Gate values are the values ADR section 8.3 pre-registers (section 8.1: timing and image-quality values are fixed now). The M1 run supplies no gate value: one run is not a calibration, and every tightening proposal it implies would loosen (calibration_record), so none is applied.

globals.worlds (V2 committed digests), globals.settings (V7 frozen settings), globals.devices and globals.binary are copied from the captured run: world digests, splat and chunk counts, file bytes and path_sha256 from probe/summary.json worlds.<w>; gen_sha and the codec params from the run's worlds/<w>.world.manifest.json; the tuned settings, visible cap and far plane from probe/summary.json settings; the adapter from worlds.A.driver.adapter.
The world digests are reproducible: the same file_sha256 for A in runs 42427296940 and 42512864344, and for T0 in runs 42406495103, 42465914667, 42427296940 and 42512864344.

An ADR condition whose signal the lane does not publish yet is absent from this file (section 8.1: a gate whose prerequisite has not landed is absent, and adding it later is a tightening). absent_until_prerequisite names each one; nothing here is PENDING, and the verdict module never scores an absent condition as a pass.

absent_until_prerequisite.V1-psi: PSI recorder is reported, not gating, until calibrated (ADR V1); V1 here gates the contention step record only
absent_until_prerequisite.V4: used only for the R breakdown; P1 uses the wall-clock interval
absent_until_prerequisite.V5-pose: pose error at holds is not published by the probe
absent_until_prerequisite.V6: throttle reasons are not published (nvidia_smi.csv is section 9.3, not yet in the lane)
absent_until_prerequisite.V9-unique-uploaded: unique uploaded bytes are not published; the probe publishes total uploads and the oracle's lower bound expected_unique_upload_flat
absent_until_prerequisite.V9-drawn-floor: the probe publishes expected_drawn_upper_bound (frustum chunks, no LOD), not the manifest's expected drawn count; the per-segment drawn floor is not pre-registered
absent_until_prerequisite.G1-log: DEVICE_LOST / OOM / allocation failure are not published as signals; G1 here is exit 0 plus the final marker
absent_until_prerequisite.G5: cold start to first complete frame is not published
absent_until_prerequisite.G9: not published on the flat route; GSQ counters arrive with the compressed arm
absent_until_prerequisite.G14: the probe's moving window excludes holds; G14 counts every frame outside 1 s after a teleport (BV-13a pass A)
absent_until_prerequisite.G15: the probe's moving window does not apply the 1 s post-teleport exclusion of section 8.3 (BV-13a pass A)
absent_until_prerequisite.P1: same window mismatch as G15 (BV-13a pass A); HLOD-gated, printed for flat

reprime_records.reason: BV-C7 (#1381) primes Tier A as plain GSQ (encoding plain_v3_gsq); the committed digests were the uncompressed M1 world, so V2 was INVALID on every GSQ run (#1389). Same generator: path_sha256, generator_params_sha, splat_count and chunk_count are unchanged; only the encoded file (file_sha256, file_bytes) and its cache key (gen_sha) change.
reprime_records.source: probe/summary.json worlds.A and steps/cache_check.json worlds.A.gen_sha (verify_ok true) of artifacts beyond-vram-flythrough-A-42629658168-1 (branch bv-13a, 9cf16a03a9e2bf22f13cc8da9cf4d3760210d7e9) and beyond-vram-flythrough-A-42626103664-1 (branch bv-lat, cee13648fd256a202bde1aae75c3f61f5cf1147e); both runs agree on every field
reprime_records.calibration_record: No gate value changes: the gate values are the ADR 8.3 pre-registered values and were never calibrated from a world digest (provenance.method). No tightening proposal is applied from two runs. V2 stays an exact comparison; a flat Tier A run is INVALID on V2 from now on, because V2 keys the committed digests by world name and the lane's Tier A is GSQ.

V2.source_field: probe/summary.json worlds.<w>.{world_file_sha256, generator_params_sha, splat_count, chunk_count, file_bytes}; steps/cache_check.json or steps/generate.json status

V5.repetitions: tiers value: pass A cold then warm

V7.exclusions: load rows before the first pass (settings_whole_run) are reported, never counted

V8.source_field: build_info.json {binary_kind, scons_args, sha256, provenance}; probe/summary.json binary.sha256

V9-peak-resident.unit: fraction of the world's GPU-equivalent bytes

M1-settle.exclusions: none; needed > cap is INVALID until the priority proof exists (ADR section 10, M1)

V10.unit: read bytes / the path oracle's expected unique stored bytes
V10.source_field: steps/probe.json data.cache.{residency.resident_fraction, v10.read_bytes, v10.expected_unique_stored_bytes, host_cache}; a BV-13a control judges its own record of the same shape
V10.window: the probe process: mincore residency of every world file right before it starts (D-14 item 2, <= residency_max_fraction), block-read bytes of the probe tree while it runs (ru_inblock of the reaped descendants, D-14 item 3); the oracle is summed over every world the probe flew. The repeat pass reads from the page cache and adds no block reads, so the whole process stands for the cold pass
V10.exclusions: none; host_cache is recorded, never gated (D-14 item 4)

G2a.window: every frame of the path run (peak)

G6.window: stop checkpoints (path kind stop), every repetition
G6.exclusions: C0 (cold start), C4 and C7 (teleports, G6t)

G10.unit: readback intervals with an overlap-record drop
G10.window: checkpoint settle and hold rows of every repetition, the load settle at C0 included
